projects.title: Listnd
projects.description:
Udacity iOS Nanodegree Capstone Project

Developed a music to-do iOS application built with Spotify's API that lets a user search for artists, albums, songs and preview a 30 second song sample. The user can save an album, artist or song that the want to listen at a later time. When the user wants to listen to the saved song, they can select the Spotify option and it will open the Spotify application and start playing the song.

- Built networking and parsing interface that communicates with Spotify's API
- Utilized Core Data to persist the data from Spotify

**Will be available in the App Store soon**

projects.title: Virtual Tourist
projects.description:
Udacity iOS Nanaodegree Project

iOS application that lets a user drop a pin on a map of the world to download pictures for that location using the Flickr API.

- Built networking and parsing interface that request, receives and processes data from Flickr's API
- Utilized Core Data to persist the photographs used by the user
